## Research Experience

### AI Adoption and Corporate Financing


- Analyzed over 10,000 firm-level observations from Chinese A-share listed companies, using financial data from CSMAR and corporate annual reports covering 2011–2023.
- Constructed an AI adoption index using annual report text analysis and applied firm and year fixed-effects regression models in Stata to examine the relationship between AI adoption and supply chain financing.
- Conducted robustness checks and heterogeneity analysis across firm sizes to evaluate the consistency of empirical findings.
- Found a positive association between AI adoption and supply chain finance, with stronger relationships among medium-sized and large firms than among smaller firms.
- Publication: [View Published Research Paper](https://aemps.ewapub.com/article/view/38240)

### CMIP6 Climate Projections for Southeast Asia

- Processed CMIP6 climate simulations and ERA5 reanalysis data using Python to study temperature and precipitation patterns across 10 Southeast Asian cities.
- Evaluated historical climate simulations from 2005 to 2014 and analyzed future projections under the SSP5-8.5 scenario.
- Identified projected increases in extreme temperatures and examined potential heat and flood risks in Southeast Asia.
- Preprint: EarthArxiv: https://eartharxiv.org/repository/view/6506/
